Metadata.siteDescription: Enterprise-grade data tables for React and Shadcn with URL state, advanced filters, i18n and full code ownership.
Metadata.homeTitle: YaYaw Table - A complete table system, the Shadcn way
Metadata.homeDescription: Install a production-ready table system with one command. Keep full ownership, ship advanced UX and avoid glue code.
Metadata.exampleDescription: Explore a real interactive YaYaw Table setup with server-side pagination, filters, grouping and bulk actions.
Metadata.docsDescription: Install, configure and ship YaYaw Table in production with complete guides and API references.

Home.heroDescription: YaYaw Table gives teams shipping internal products a complete table workflow: advanced filters, URL state, bulk flows and i18n with code that lives in your app.
Home.installHint: Works with your existing Shadcn + TanStack stack.

proofItems.ownership: Registry installation copies the full UI layer into your codebase.
proofItems.url: URL state is built-in for sorting, pagination, grouping and filters.
proofItems.i18n: Native i18n keys across table, filters, views and forms.
proofItems.dx: Config-driven architecture keeps feature rollout predictable.

enableRowSelection.label: Enable row selection
enableRowSelection.description: Enable row checkboxes and bulk selection behaviors.

showSelectionColumn.label: Show selection column (code)
showSelectionColumn.description: Control the selection column through config (`columns.visible`), not from the options menu.

showActionsColumn.label: Show actions column (code)
showActionsColumn.description: Control the actions column through config (`columns.visible`), not from the options menu.

enableRowClickEdit.label: Enable row click edit drawer
enableRowClickEdit.description: Open the edit drawer when a non-interactive row area is clicked. Enabling this disables inline edit in this demo.

enableColumnFilters.label: Enable column filters
enableColumnFilters.description: Enable search and filter controls in toolbar and menus.

enableSorting.label: Enable sorting
enableSorting.description: Enable sorting from headers and the options menu.

enableColumnDnd.label: Enable column drag and drop
enableColumnDnd.description: Enable drag and drop controls in headers and menus.

enablePagination.label: Enable pagination
enablePagination.description: Enable page navigation and page-size selector.

export.label: Enable toolbar export
export.description: Show the CSV export button in the toolbar.

bulkExport.label: Enable bulk export
bulkExport.description: Show the CSV export action in the bulk menu.

actionsAsIcons.label: Show actions as icons
actionsAsIcons.description: Render toolbar action buttons as icon-only with tooltips.

showToolbar.label: Show toolbar
showToolbar.description: Show search and toolbar actions (Add, Export, Options).

showToolbarHeader.label: Show title and description
showToolbarHeader.description: Show the toolbar title and description block.

allowCreate.label: Allow create
allowCreate.description: Show and enable the Add item action.

allowEdit.label: Allow row edit action (menu)
allowEdit.description: Show and enable the Edit action in the row actions menu.

allowDuplicate.label: Allow row duplicate
allowDuplicate.description: Show and enable the row duplicate action.

allowDelete.label: Allow row delete
allowDelete.description: Show and enable the row delete action.

allowBulkEdit.label: Allow bulk edit
allowBulkEdit.description: Show and enable the bulk edit action.

allowBulkDelete.label: Allow bulk delete
allowBulkDelete.description: Show and enable the bulk delete action.

allowInlineEdit.label: Allow direct cell editing
allowInlineEdit.description: Allow direct cell editing inside table rows. Enabling this disables row click edit in this demo.

densityMode.label: Density mode
densityMode.description: Choose row spacing for table headers and cells.
